_source: VKF / AEAI, the sheets of symbols for fire-protection plans dated 16.12.2016: «BS-Symbole.pdf» (German) and «pictogrammes PI.pdf» (French), page 1, groups 1.0 «Fluchtwege» / «Voies d'évacuation» and 2.1 «Feuerwiderstände» / «Résistances au feu». Each colour is the sheet's own «Farbcode RGB» / «code couleur RJB», read from the page's text and found again as the true colour (DXF group code 420) of the matching pictogram file in both language sets; the two entries the sheet gives no RGB column for in group 1.0 are the pictogram files' own colours. The sheets state no document number, so none is cited: the engineer's decision of 2026-10-03 is to cite what is printed. The sheets are not in the repository; the engineer keeps them beside it (folders VKF/ and AEAI/). Group 2.2 «Abschlüsse» / «Fermetures» of the same page gives the four doors: their labels are the sheets' own, their colours the «Farbcode RGB» printed beside them (the footnote mark the sheet sets after «EI 30» is left out). `shapes` are the proportions of two pictograms, measured on the files the VKF / AEAI distribute with the sheets: «Sortie de secours.jpeg» (825 x 590 px: a shaft 500 long and 200 wide, a head 325 long and 590 wide) and «Porte coulissante EI 30.jpeg» (1771 x 296 px: a bar 118 thick, a half head 354 long rising to 296). «Porte EI 30.jpeg» is a quarter disc and needs no number.
_note: What a fire-protection plan is drawn with (calc/domains/fire.py, calc/domains/fire_svg.py): the colour a wall's fire resistance is drawn in, the colours of the escape routes, the doors with a fire resistance, and the proportions of the two pictograms drawn as shapes. `label` is the German of the sheet, word for word, and the key of the glossary (calc/i18n/strings.json), which carries the French of the AEAI sheet. Only what the drawing uses is transcribed -- the engineer's decision of 2026-10-05 keeps the plan to the symbols of the top of the AEAI's sample legend: the glazing, the roller shutters, the lift doors and the pictograms of the other groups are not.
